thread:
sarah.ops: :rotating_light: paging from alerting - auth-service 5xx spike + token churn in APAC. sudden high-volume from many distinct IPs, looks like credential stuffing + scraper fanout. seeing 11k reqs/s hitting /v1/chat/ and /v1/embeddings. dumping sample IPs to #sec. paging @leo-oncall @mike-sre @olivia-cs
incident-bot: INC created INC-2026-0428: auth spike / possible credential stuffing. severity=P2. Paging rota: leo-oncall -> eve-oncall handoff in 1h.
leo-oncall: acknowledged. I'll take lead. initial plan: 1) raise WAF blocking for known bad UA/IP lists 2) lower anonymous per-IP rate to 10r/s 3) disable embeddings batch endpoint for public traffic 4) enable geo-rate-slice for APAC and increase stricter quotas. doing 1-3 now.
mike-sre: running mitigations now. applying WAF rule and rate limits via admin API. commands:
``` 
# apply ip block list (example)
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/waf/rules -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"mode":"block","match":"ip:203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.0/24"}'
# update rate limit
curl -X PATCH https://admin.redwood/api/ratelimit/global -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"endpoint":"/v1/","scope":"per_ip","limit":10,"window_sec":1}'
```
mike-sre: WAF rule applied :white_check_mark: rate limit updated :white_check_mark: temporarily disabled /v1/embeddings/batch for public tenants (policy id: EMB-BATCH-PUBLIC-LOCK). seeing 60% drop in token burn in APAC within 30s.
olivia-cs: we've got 4 support tickets reporting 429s from enterprise customers in APAC. I'm drafting a short status blurb to send to affected accounts. Will include ETA and mitigation steps.
sarah.ops: good. capturing sample IPs and user agents now and will push to sec team slack. also enabling short-term quota overrides for SSO-authenticated enterprise customers to avoid noise.
leo-oncall: monitoring dashboards - tailing logs shows continued scanning but much reduced. still a noisy pool of ~300 IPs rotating. set up temporary WAF captcha challenge rule for suspicious UA patterns to reduce false positives.
incident-bot: deploy started: EMB-BATCH-PUBLIC-LOCK -> disable endpoint flag (deploy id: d-98765).
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: d-98765 @ 2585550284.
leo-oncall: next steps: 1) escalation to sec for long-term block list + intel 2) run account impact report 3) handoff to eve-oncall at 09:00 UTC for monitoring and cleanup. mike, can you create a post-mortem stub?
mike-sre: creating INC-2026-0428 postmortem doc and will attach IP samples + rate-limit diffs. starting capture of evicted sessions and any customer 429 logs.
olivia-cs: sending customer notice now: short note saying we've mitigated bot surge, some may see transient 429s, please contact if persistent.
sarah.ops: agree. tagging security and legal to review if credentials were exfiltrated or if we need wider disclosure.
eve-oncall: joining the thread early for handoff. thanks team — I'll monitor next 6 hours and keep CS updated. if we see resurgence, recommend full IP blackhole + require CAPTCHA for anonymous traffic. :thumbsup:
leo-oncall: handing off now. summary pinned: mitigations applied (WAF blocks, per-ip limit=10r/s, embeddings batch disabled for public, captcha challenges for suspicious UA), customer communication in progress, postmortem created.
sarah.ops: closing active page for now. will reopen if metrics climb above thresholds. great job everyone. :party_parrot:
